title: 2024 Bowman #96 Jordan Lawlar Arizona Diamondbacks Baseball Card
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText:
This 2024 Bowman #96 Jordan Lawlar RC trading card features the up-and-coming rookie from the Arizona Diamondbacks. The card is made from high-quality card stock, measuring at a standard size of 35 Pt. It is an original licensed reprint from Bowman, a trusted manufacturer in the baseball card industry.

The card is perfect for collectors and fans of Major League Baseball, showcasing the player's name, team, and card number. The card also includes English language text, describing the player's stats and achievements. This is a must-have for any baseball card collection, highlighting the player's talent and potential.
